theorems.name: place_capacity
theorems.doc: (S) `place` never lets the file grow past the cap, and the row it places lies wholly inside the new file (given the old slot, if any, was in it).
theorems.statement:
theorem place_capacity (file_len : U32) (prev : Option Slot) (len : U32)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024) (hfile : file_len.val ≤ 16777216)
    (hprev : ∀ p, prev = some p → slotEnd p ≤ file_len.val)
    {off plan fl} (h : place file_len prev len = ok (.Ok (off, plan, fl))) :
    fl.val ≤ 16777216 ∧ off.val + len.val ≤ fl.val
theorems.proof:
theorem place_capacity (file_len : U32) (prev : Option Slot) (len : U32)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024) (hfile : file_len.val ≤ 16777216)
    (hprev : ∀ p, prev = some p → slotEnd p ≤ file_len.val)
    {off plan fl} (h : place file_len prev len = ok (.Ok (off, plan, fl))) :
    fl.val ≤ 16777216 ∧ off.val + len.val ≤ fl.val := by
  obtain ⟨hlen1, hlen2⟩ := hlen
  have hmf : MAX_FILE.val = 16777216 := max_file_val
  unfold place at h
  cases prev with
  | none =>
    h5i_invert h <;> (try obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h) <;>
      (simp only [slotEnd] at *; h5i_ok_facts; scalar_tac)
  | some p =>
    have hp := hprev p rfl
    h5i_invert h <;> (try obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h) <;>
      (simp only [slotEnd] at *; h5i_ok_facts; scalar_tac)

theorems.name: place_local
theorems.doc: (S) Every byte `place` writes (its `void` and `data` regions) lies in fresh space at/after the old end of file or in the record's *own* old slot, never in another record's bytes.
theorems.statement:
theorem place_local (file_len : U32) (prev : Option Slot) (len : U32)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024) (hfile : file_len.val ≤ 16777216)
    {off plan fl} (h : place file_len prev len = ok (.Ok (off, plan, fl))) :
    ∀ q : Nat, (inSlot (Slot.mk 0#u32 NO_TAG plan.data.off plan.data.len) q ∨
                inSlot (Slot.mk 0#u32 NO_TAG plan.void.off plan.void.len) q) →
      (file_len.val ≤ q) ∨ (∃ w, prev = some w ∧ inSlot w q)
theorems.proof:
theorem place_local (file_len : U32) (prev : Option Slot) (len : U32)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024) (hfile : file_len.val ≤ 16777216)
    {off plan fl} (h : place file_len prev len = ok (.Ok (off, plan, fl))) :
    ∀ q : Nat, (inSlot (Slot.mk 0#u32 NO_TAG plan.data.off plan.data.len) q ∨
                inSlot (Slot.mk 0#u32 NO_TAG plan.void.off plan.void.len) q) →
      (file_len.val ≤ q) ∨ (∃ w, prev = some w ∧ inSlot w q) := by
  obtain ⟨hlen1, hlen2⟩ := hlen
  intro q hq
  unfold place at h
  cases prev with
  | none =>
    h5i_invert h <;> (try obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h) <;>
      (left; rcases hq with hh | hh <;>
        (simp only [inSlot, slotEnd, no_region_off, no_region_len] at hh; scalar_tac))
  | some p =>
    h5i_invert h <;> (try obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h) <;>
      (rcases hq with hh | hh <;>
        simp only [inSlot, slotEnd, no_region_off, no_region_len] at hh <;>
        first
          | (left; scalar_tac)
          | (right; exact ⟨p, rfl, by simp only [inSlot, slotEnd]; scalar_tac⟩))

theorems.name: place_inplace_fits
theorems.doc: (S) An in-place rewrite (the file does not grow) happens only when the row fits the old slot, and then it writes exactly the old slot (nothing voided).
theorems.statement:
theorem place_inplace_fits (file_len : U32) (p : Slot) (len : U32)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024) (hfile : file_len.val ≤ 16777216)
    {off plan fl} (h : place file_len (some p) len = ok (.Ok (off, plan, fl)))
    (hinplace : fl = file_len) :
    len.val ≤ p.length.val ∧ plan.data.off = p.offset ∧ plan.data.len = p.length ∧
      plan.void = NO_REGION
theorems.proof:
theorem place_inplace_fits (file_len : U32) (p : Slot) (len : U32)
    (hlen : 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024) (hfile : file_len.val ≤ 16777216)
    {off plan fl} (h : place file_len (some p) len = ok (.Ok (off, plan, fl)))
    (hinplace : fl = file_len) :
    len.val ≤ p.length.val ∧ plan.data.off = p.offset ∧ plan.data.len = p.length ∧
      plan.void = NO_REGION := by
  obtain ⟨hlen1, hlen2⟩ := hlen
  unfold place at h
  h5i_invert h <;> (try obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h) <;>
    first
      | exact ⟨by scalar_tac, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
      | (exfalso
         have hadd := add_ok_val (by assumption)
         rw [hinplace] at hadd
         omega)

theorems.name: place_grow_relocates
theorems.doc: (S) A row that grows past its old slot is never written in place: it is appended at the old end of file and its old slot is voided whole.
theorems.statement:
theorem place_grow_relocates (file_len : U32) (p : Slot) (len : U32)
    (hgrow : p.length.val < len.val)
    {off plan fl} (h : place file_len (some p) len = ok (.Ok (off, plan, fl))) :
    off = file_len ∧ plan.data.off = file_len ∧ plan.data.len = len ∧
      plan.void.off = p.offset ∧ plan.void.len = p.length
theorems.proof:
theorem place_grow_relocates (file_len : U32) (p : Slot) (len : U32)
    (hgrow : p.length.val < len.val)
    {off plan fl} (h : place file_len (some p) len = ok (.Ok (off, plan, fl))) :
    off = file_len ∧ plan.data.off = file_len ∧ plan.data.len = len ∧
      plan.void.off = p.offset ∧ plan.void.len = p.length := by
  unfold place at h
  h5i_invert h <;> (try obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h) <;>
    first
      | exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
      | (exfalso; scalar_tac)

theorems.name: strike_relocates
theorems.doc: (S) When an add strikes out the spool that held its tag, the struck row (one byte longer) is appended at or past the old end of file, and the spool's whole old slot (one byte shorter than the new row) is voided: it is never rewritten in place, where it would overrun into the next record. Rules out the `strike_inplace` mutant.
theorems.statement:
theorem strike_relocates (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    {ws id plan bid btag bplan}
    (h : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan (.Done bid btag bplan)))) :
    s.file_len.val ≤ bplan.data.off.val ∧ bplan.void.len.val + 1 = bplan.data.len.val
theorems.proof:
theorem strike_relocates (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    {ws id plan bid btag bplan}
    (h : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan (.Done bid btag bplan)))) :
    s.file_len.val ≤ bplan.data.off.val ∧ bplan.void.len.val + 1 = bplan.data.len.val := by
  have := max_rec_val; have := max_id_val; have := max_file_val
  have hw : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) ⦃ res =>
      ∀ ws id plan bid btag bplan, res = .Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan (.Done bid btag bplan)) →
        s.file_len.val ≤ bplan.data.off.val ∧ bplan.void.len.val + 1 = bplan.data.len.val ⦄ := by
    unfold transition add_spool place
    by_cases hl : len.val ≤ 1024
    all_goals spool_auto
    all_goals (intros; simp_all <;> scalar_tac)
  exact post_of_ok hw h ws id plan bid btag bplan rfl

theorems.name: fresh_id_is_new
theorems.doc: (S) The spool id `AddSpool` hands out is new: no record already has it. Rules out the `fresh_id_reuse` mutant (a new spool shadowing an existing record's storage). Needs only that existing ids are `≤ last_id`.
theorems.statement:
theorem fresh_id_is_new (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    (hids : ∀ sl ∈ s.slots.val, sl.id.val ≤ s.last_id.val)
    {ws id plan st} (h : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan st))) :
    ∀ sl ∈ s.slots.val, sl.id ≠ id
theorems.proof:
theorem fresh_id_is_new (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    (hids : ∀ sl ∈ s.slots.val, sl.id.val ≤ s.last_id.val)
    {ws id plan st} (h : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan st))) :
    ∀ sl ∈ s.slots.val, sl.id ≠ id := by
  have hid := addspool_id a s tag len rd hcap hicap h
  intro sl hsl heq
  have h2 := hids sl hsl
  have hv : sl.id.val = id.val := by rw [heq]
  omega

theorems.name: add_len_ok
theorems.doc: (S) An add is only accepted for a row of `1 ..= MAX_REC` bytes (one that serialises in `max_record_width`). Rules out the `add_no_len_check` mutant.
theorems.statement:
theorem add_len_ok (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    {ws id plan st} (h : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan st))) :
    1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024
theorems.proof:
theorem add_len_ok (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    {ws id plan st} (h : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan st))) :
    1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024 := by
  have := max_rec_val; have := max_id_val
  have hw : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) ⦃ res =>
      ∀ ws id plan st, res = .Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan st) → 1 ≤ len.val ∧ len.val ≤ 1024 ⦄ := by
    unfold transition add_spool
    by_cases hl : len.val ≤ 1024
    all_goals spool_auto
    all_goals (intros; simp_all <;> scalar_tac)
  exact post_of_ok hw h ws id plan st rfl

theorems.name: edit_same_writes_nothing
theorems.doc: (S) An edit that changes nothing writes nothing (`CsvDb::insert` returns early for an equal record): no region of the file is touched and it does not grow.
theorems.statement:
theorem edit_same_writes_nothing (a : Device) (s : Store) (id : U32) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    {ns plan} (h : transition a s (.EditSpool id tag len true rd) = ok (.Ok (some ns, Reply.Wrote plan))) :
    plan = NO_PLAN ∧ ns.file_len = s.file_len
theorems.proof:
theorem edit_same_writes_nothing (a : Device) (s : Store) (id : U32) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    {ns plan} (h : transition a s (.EditSpool id tag len true rd) = ok (.Ok (some ns, Reply.Wrote plan))) :
    plan = NO_PLAN ∧ ns.file_len = s.file_len := by
  have hw : transition a s (.EditSpool id tag len true rd) ⦃ res =>
      ∀ ns plan, res = .Ok (some ns, Reply.Wrote plan) → plan = NO_PLAN ∧ ns.file_len = s.file_len ⦄ := by
    unfold transition edit_spool
    spool_auto
    all_goals (intros; simp_all)
  exact post_of_ok hw h ns plan rfl

theorems.name: delete_absent_noop
theorems.doc: (S) Deleting a spool that does not exist changes nothing.
theorems.statement:
theorem delete_absent_noop (s : Store) (id : U32)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    (habs : s.slots.val.find? (fun x => decide (x.id = id)) = none) :
    ∃ r, transition ⟨true⟩ s (.DeleteSpool id) = ok (.Ok (none, r))
theorems.proof:
theorem delete_absent_noop (s : Store) (id : U32)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    (habs : s.slots.val.find? (fun x => decide (x.id = id)) = none) :
    ∃ r, transition ⟨true⟩ s (.DeleteSpool id) = ok (.Ok (none, r)) := by
  have hw : transition ⟨true⟩ s (.DeleteSpool id) ⦃ res => ∃ r, res = .Ok (none, r) ⦄ := by
    unfold transition delete_spool
    spool_auto
    all_goals simp_all
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 hw
  obtain ⟨rr, rfl⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨rr, hr⟩

theorems.name: unauth_refused
theorems.doc: (S) A request that did not decrypt (`admin = false`) never mutates: every write command is refused with `Forbidden`, before any state change.
theorems.statement:
theorem unauth_refused (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len id : U32) (same rd : Bool) :
    transition ⟨false⟩ s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Err .Forbidden) ∧
    transition ⟨false⟩ s (.EditSpool id tag len same rd) = ok (.Err .Forbidden) ∧
    transition ⟨false⟩ s (.DeleteSpool id) = ok (.Err .Forbidden)
theorems.proof:
theorem unauth_refused (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len id : U32) (same rd : Bool) :
    transition ⟨false⟩ s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Err .Forbidden) ∧
    transition ⟨false⟩ s (.EditSpool id tag len same rd) = ok (.Err .Forbidden) ∧
    transition ⟨false⟩ s (.DeleteSpool id) = ok (.Err .Forbidden) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> (unfold transition; simp)

theorems.name: committed_rows_readable
theorems.doc: (S) The kernel only commits a row that the boot loader reads back: an accepted add, or an accepted edit that writes, had `readable` set. Upstream writes such rows (a note over 256 bytes or with a line break) and its whole inventory is unavailable after the next reset (found in Renode). Rules out the `unreadable_add` mutant.
theorems.statement:
theorem committed_rows_readable (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len id : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max) :
    (∀ ws r, transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, r)) → rd = true) ∧
    (∀ ws r, transition a s (.EditSpool id tag len false rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, r)) → rd = true)
theorems.proof:
theorem committed_rows_readable (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len id : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max) :
    (∀ ws r, transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, r)) → rd = true) ∧
    (∀ ws r, transition a s (.EditSpool id tag len false rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, r)) → rd = true) := by
  have := max_rec_val; have := max_id_val
  constructor
  · intro ws r h
    have hw : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) ⦃ res => ∀ ws r, res = .Ok (ws, r) → rd = true ⦄ := by
      unfold transition add_spool
      by_cases hl : len.val ≤ 1024
      all_goals spool_auto
      all_goals (intros; simp_all)
    exact post_of_ok hw h ws r rfl
  · intro ws r h
    have hw : transition a s (.EditSpool id tag len false rd) ⦃ res => ∀ ws r, res = .Ok (ws, r) → rd = true ⦄ := by
      unfold transition edit_spool
      by_cases hl : len.val ≤ 1024
      all_goals spool_auto
      all_goals (intros; simp_all)
    exact post_of_ok hw h ws r rfl

theorems.name: sound
theorems.doc: Every accepted `Query` writes nothing, for all actors and states.
theorems.statement: theorem sound : H5iAppLib.ReadOnly.Sound read_only transition writesOf
theorems.proof:
theorem sound : H5iAppLib.ReadOnly.Sound read_only transition writesOf := by
  apply H5iAppLib.ReadOnly.sound_of_spec
  intro a s c hro
  cases c <;> simp [read_only] at hro
  unfold transition
  simp [H5iAppLib.OnOk, writesOf]

theorems.name: transition_total
theorems.doc: (C) `transition` never panics / overflows, for any actor, store and command (given the record and index counts fit a `usize`). A panic on the device is a reset.
theorems.statement:
theorem transition_total (a : Device) (s : Store) (c : Command)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max) :
    ∃ r, transition a s c = ok r
theorems.proof:
theorem transition_total (a : Device) (s : Store) (c : Command)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max) :
    ∃ r, transition a s c = ok r := by
  have h : transition a s c ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
    unfold transition
    cases c <;> spool_auto
  obtain ⟨r, hr, -⟩ := (WP.spec_equiv_exists _ _).1 h
  exact ⟨r, hr⟩

theorems.name: addspool_id
theorems.statement:
theorem addspool_id (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    {ws id plan st} (h : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan st))) :
    id.val = s.last_id.val + 1
theorems.proof:
theorem addspool_id (a : Device) (s : Store) (tag : Tag) (len : U32) (rd : Bool)
    (hcap : s.slots.val.length < Usize.max) (hicap : s.index.val.length < Usize.max)
    {ws id plan st} (h : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) = ok (.Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan st))) :
    id.val = s.last_id.val + 1 := by
  have := max_rec_val; have := max_id_val
  have hw : transition a s (.AddSpool tag len rd) ⦃ res =>
      ∀ ws id plan st, res = .Ok (ws, Reply.Added id plan st) → id.val = s.last_id.val + 1 ⦄ := by
    unfold transition add_spool
    by_cases hl : len.val ≤ 1024
    all_goals spool_auto
    all_goals (intros; simp_all)
  exact post_of_ok hw h ws id plan st rfl

theorems.name: lookup_spec
theorems.statement:
@[step] theorem lookup_spec (slots : Slice Slot) (id : U32) :
    lookup slots id ⦃ r => r = slots.val.find? (fun s => decide (s.id = id)) ⦄
theorems.proof:
@[step] theorem lookup_spec (slots : Slice Slot) (id : U32) :
    lookup slots id ⦃ r => r = slots.val.find? (fun s => decide (s.id = id)) ⦄ := by
  unfold lookup lookup_loop
  h5i_search_find slots.val (fun s => decide (s.id = id))

theorems.name: index_get_spec
theorems.statement:
@[step] theorem index_get_spec (index : Slice IndexEntry) (tag : Tag) :
    index_get index tag ⦃ r => r = (index.val.find? (fun e => tagEq e.tag tag)).map (fun e => e.id) ⦄
theorems.proof:
@[step] theorem index_get_spec (index : Slice IndexEntry) (tag : Tag) :
    index_get index tag ⦃ r => r = (index.val.find? (fun e => tagEq e.tag tag)).map (fun e => e.id) ⦄ := by
  unfold index_get index_get_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (H5iAppLib.loop_search index.val (fun e => tagEq e.tag tag) id
    (fun _ x => some x.id) none _ ?step 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; simp only [id] at hr; rw [hr, searchFrom_find _ _ (fun x : IndexEntry => x.id)]; simp
  · intro j hj; unfold index_get_loop.body; h5i_step

theorems.name: index_insert_spec
theorems.doc: `index_insert` keeps at most one more entry than it was given.
theorems.statement:
@[step] theorem index_insert_spec (index : Slice IndexEntry) (tag : Tag) (id : U32)
    (hcap : index.val.length < Usize.max) :
    index_insert index tag id ⦃ r =>
      r.val = index.val.map (fun x => if tagEq x.tag tag then ⟨tag, id⟩ else x) ++
        (if index.val.any (fun x => tagEq x.tag tag) then [] else [⟨tag, id⟩]) ⦄
theorems.proof:
@[step] theorem index_insert_spec (index : Slice IndexEntry) (tag : Tag) (id : U32)
    (hcap : index.val.length < Usize.max) :
    index_insert index tag id ⦃ r =>
      r.val = index.val.map (fun x => if tagEq x.tag tag then ⟨tag, id⟩ else x) ++
        (if index.val.any (fun x => tagEq x.tag tag) then [] else [⟨tag, id⟩]) ⦄ := by
  unfold index_insert
  have hloop : index_insert_loop index tag id (alloc.vec.Vec.new IndexEntry) false 0#usize ⦃ r =>
      (r.1.val, r.2) = (index.val.map (fun x => if tagEq x.tag tag then ⟨tag, id⟩ else x),
        index.val.any (fun x => tagEq x.tag tag)) ⦄ := by
    unfold index_insert_loop
    apply WP.spec_mono (loop_fold2 index.val (fun (v : alloc.vec.Vec IndexEntry) (b : Bool) => (v.val, b))
      (insStep tag id) (fun v _ i => v.val.length ≤ i) _ ?step
      (alloc.vec.Vec.new IndexEntry) false 0#usize (by simp) (by simp))
    · intro r ⟨hr, _⟩
      simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, List.drop_zero, vec_new_val, insStep_fold, List.nil_append,
        Bool.false_or] using hr
    · intro a b i hi hI; unfold index_insert_loop.body; h5i_step [insStep]
  step* <;> simp_all

theorems.name: index_remove_tag_spec
theorems.statement:
@[step] theorem index_remove_tag_spec (index : Slice IndexEntry) (tag : Tag) :
    index_remove_tag index tag ⦃ r => r.val = index.val.filter (fun e => !tagEq e.tag tag) ⦄
theorems.proof:
@[step] theorem index_remove_tag_spec (index : Slice IndexEntry) (tag : Tag) :
    index_remove_tag index tag ⦃ r => r.val = index.val.filter (fun e => !tagEq e.tag tag) ⦄ := by
  unfold index_remove_tag index_remove_tag_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_fold index.val (fun v : alloc.vec.Vec IndexEntry => v.val)
    (fun acc x => if !tagEq x.tag tag then acc ++ [x] else acc) (fun v i => v.val.length ≤ i) _ ?step
    (alloc.vec.Vec.new IndexEntry) 0#usize (by simp) (by simp))
  · intro r hr

def place
  (file_len : Std.U32) (prev : Option Slot) (len : Std.U32) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Std.U32 × Plan × Std.U32) Error)
  := do
  match prev with

      then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Full)
      else

        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (file_len,

                      { file_len := fl2, last_id := id, slots := slots2, index
                      }, Reply.Added id plan (Strike.Done b2.id
                      { b2.tag with dash := i } bplan)))
                  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
                      ((Option Store) × Reply) (core.convert.FromSame Error)
                      residual
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry_traitFromResidualResult.from_residual
            ((Option Store) × Reply) (core.convert.FromSame Error) residual
    else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.Unreadable)
  else ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.TooBig)

slotEnd.code:
/-- Last byte+1 of a slot's region in the `.db` file. -/
def slotEnd (s : Slot) : Nat := s.offset.val + s.length.val

inSlot.code:
/-- Position `p` lies inside slot `s`'s region. -/
def inSlot (s : Slot) (p : Nat) : Prop := s.offset.val ≤ p ∧ p < slotEnd s

def writesOf : Option Store → List Store
  | none => []

tagEq.code:
/-- Tag equality as the kernel computes it. -/
def tagEq (a b : Tag) : Bool := decide (a.base = b.base) && decide (a.dash = b.dash)

replaceOne.code:
/-- `replace_slot`'s per-element rewrite. -/
def replaceOne (id : U32) (ns s : Slot) : Slot := if s.id = id then ns else s
